title: Fiverr Search Gig Scraper
description: Search Fiverr gigs by keyword and extract comprehensive gig data including seller info, pricing, ratings, and more. 🎯

scrapeMode.title: Scrape Mode 🎛️
scrapeMode.description: search = fast listing only (48 gigs/page). search+details = open every gig page for packages, description, FAQ, reviews, seller bio (slower, ~1 request per gig). details = only scrape the Gig URLs you provide below.
enumTitles: Search + open each gig page (full data)

gigUrls.title: Gig URLs 🔗
gigUrls.description: Fiverr gig URLs to scrape in detail (used in 'details' mode, also appended in other modes). e.g. https://www.fiverr.com/username/gig-slug

maxReviews.title: Reviews per gig 💬
maxReviews.description: How many latest reviews to include from the gig page (max ~5-10 embedded).

detailConcurrency.title: Detail page concurrency ⚡
detailConcurrency.description: Parallel gig-page requests. Keep low (2-5) to avoid blocks.

query.title: Search Query 🔍
query.sectionDescription: Configure your Fiverr gig search parameters.
query.description: Service or keyword to search on Fiverr. Examples: 'logo design', 'wordpress developer', 'voice over'. Ignored if Search URL is set.

searchUrl.title: Search / Category URL (optional) 🔗
searchUrl.description: Paste any Fiverr search or category URL with filters applied, e.g. https://www.fiverr.com/search/gigs?query=logo&ref=seller_level:top_rated_seller . Overrides Search Query.

startPage.title: Start Page 📄
startPage.description: Page number to start from (each page = 48 gigs).

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages 📚
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to scrape. Each page contains 48 gigs. 5 pages ≈ 240 gigs.

includeSellerDetails.title: Include Seller Details 👤
includeSellerDetails.description: Seller username, display name, country, rating, level, languages.

includePricing.title: Include Pricing 💰
includePricing.description: Starting price, currency, delivery days, package count.

includePerformance.title: Include Performance Metrics 📈
includePerformance.description: Position, impression ID, promoted/ad flag, Fiverr's Choice, featured, buying ratings.

includeGallery.title: Include Gallery Images 🖼️
includeGallery.description: All gallery image URLs and work-sample URLs per gig.

skipPromoted.title: Skip Promoted (ad) gigs 🚫
skipPromoted.description: Exclude paid 'promoted_gigs' ads from results so positions reflect organic ranking.

dedupeGigs.title: Deduplicate gigs 🧹
dedupeGigs.description: Fiverr lists the same gig twice on a page (promoted ad slot + organic slot). OFF = keep all 48 slots per page like the original actor. ON = one row per unique gig ID.

maxItems.title: Max results 🎯
maxItems.description: Stop after this many gigs (0 = no limit). Useful to control cost.

fetchVia.title: Fetch method 🌐
fetchVia.description: direct = your proxy only. jina = every page via Jina AI Reader (r.jina.ai, free ~20 req/min without key, more with key; no proxy needed). auto = direct first, Jina as fallback when blocked.

jinaApiKey.title: Jina API key (optional) 🔑
jinaApiKey.description: Free key from jina.ai raises the rate limit (200+ req/min). Leave empty for anonymous access.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration 🌐
proxyConfiguration.description: Fiverr is protected by PerimeterX. Apify RESIDENTIAL proxies are strongly recommended.
